passages.name: my bones
passages.body:
#my bones


the rust Goddess
reaches in
and takes hold
of my bones
rotting out and
reaching in to
take hold 
of my soul
with bones of 
iron quickly
gone
I fall before
her now

Fall before her now [[Turn to page ->timelines]]

passages.name: the rust goddess
passages.body:
#the rust goddess

smoking bummed cigarettes
quoting other people’s songs
and when I think quiet enough
my own words may come to mind
So cross your legs, clasp your hands
let your thoughts wander till
the pencil starts to move
invent small gods, build bodies of rust
and pledge unceasing devotion
move the pencil, write those words
the rust goddess
has much to say
so heed well her words of wisdom 

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]
Write [[Turn to page->a question]] 
Invent a god
Ignore her [[Turn to page->this party]]

passages.name: this party
passages.body:
#this party


I was at this party
with all my friends
all standing round
and all I remember
is starting to drown
I don't mean to perseverate
upon this fancy
dinner plate
but I just wanted to
smash it to dust
light a fire,
watch it rust
because the rust Goddess
is always standing round
waiting to tear it all
to the ground

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]
Smash it [[Turn to page->Nibiru]] 
Don't smash it [[Turn to page->spring]]

passages.body:
Saint Gloria
Saint Gloria
tattered wires
wrap around
Saint Gloria
Saint Gloria
the rust Goddess
has her now
a poor sad
forsaken soul
Saint Gloria
Saint Gloria
the rust Goddess always
takes her toll

passages.name: a question
passages.body:
#a question


if I loaned you my hands
could you write
like me?
Or do you need my
eyes and heart
too?
How much is muscle
memory
place the (
isn't it
peculiar?)
hidden in the
rafters
the rust
Goddess
ever after

Yes [[Turn to page->blank poem]]
No [[Turn to page->mistress]]

passages.name: CJ
passages.body:
#CJ


seven ball
corner pocket
line the shots
and then we
drop 'em
whiskey fire burns
in my gut
making me feel lucky
an irresponsible
amount of money
on black
it's in the rust
Goddess' hands
now
spin it

Go to a party [[Turn to page->this party]]

these two things
should not fit 
together
my broken heart
and your wild locks
these two things
should not fit
together
but they do
they do
they gloriously
do
with broken bones
and graffitied 
stones
they do
they do
they gloriously
do

passages.body:
#Nibiru


the rust Goddess
spoke to me
telling me secrets
unknown
and fair Nibiru
is rising in the
east again
and what am I to do
with this?
I don't even have a
rocket

passages.body:
=|=
#my eyes


swirl and twirl
whine and dine
hold on tight
the time is nigh
with angels in my
mind
it's hard to see
you clearly dear
with so many angels in my
eyes
there's barely room
for you there

passages.name: battery
passages.body:
battery


when the angel's war
lulls
they fill me with
their excess souls
(like a battery)
pushing me to the brink of
bursting
and I can hear 
those souls
screaming inside 
me until
the angels drain 
me and  leave 
me broken

passages.body:

cheribum and seraphim
are floating in my brain
fighting against the
medicine
that makes me less insane
an endless war that
shakes and stirs
the pictures in my head
with wing and sword
they swoop and swirl
and fill my heart with dread

passages.name: simpler time
passages.body:
simpler time


I'm yearning for
a simpler time
when we were
angels in the sky
no broken bones
no bloodshot eyes
just simple wings
and clouds so high
so take my hand
and take a step
let's try and fly
with what wings
we have left

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]
Drive [[Turn to page ->take the wheel]]

passages.name: war
passages.body:
war


I fall asleep and
I am at war
flashes of angels
in shining armor
spark across my
optic nerves
their spears
grinding into my
memories
until there is a victor
until there is a 
silence
until we hang there
crucified
our weapons laid
beside us

passages.name: the things I hear
passages.body:
=|=
the things I hear


fly into the stratosphere
talk about the things I hear
all the angels there
screaming in my head
pushing my hands to deeds
untoward
wield my weapon like a sword
I just want to clarify
they need my blood to sanctify
the land to have their war
smashing shields,
clashing swords
they sent their snake
to poison my veins
switch the dreams inside
my head
until I draw my blood
for them
and spill it
on the ground
=|=
<img src="https://www.dropbox.com/s/ck9vqpwefjqv4o6/PXL_20220215_045911737.jpg?raw=1" width="500">
|==|

Maybe later [[Turn to page->war]]

passages.name: a stone from home
passages.body:
a stone from home


a stone from
home
spinning down
into the well
skittering and bouncing
past my head
where I'm hunkered
down and
hiding out
I just can't let
them find me

passages.name: God

God


and if God is
dead,
who do I pray to
about my
survivor's guilt?

passages.name: let me tell you
passages.body:
=|=
#let me tell you


there have been spiders
climbing up my arms
and I feel the web
settle over me
but this web is not
spider silk
it's carefully cultivated
chosen and bolstered
lies for the government
and I think you should 
know
we faked the moon 
landing
and that's just 
the start

=|=
<img src="https://www.dropbox.com/s/3uovuw5bnq1mnj6/PXL_20220212_041333419.jpg?raw=1" width="500">
(text-style:"subscript")["untethered from our destinies"]
|==|

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]
Follow the lies [[Turn to page -> Humira]]
Investigate the moon landing [[Turn to page ->Nibiru]]
Think about spiders [[Turn to page ->the spider]]

passages.name: crossroads
passages.body:
#crossroads


and every time we came to a
crossroad
I prayed for a red light
but your damndable luck
kept the greens
acoming
all I wanted was to steal 
a single
kiss
a prize on par with
Prometheus
and his burning flame
rising higher in my heart 
than those reds that
never came
to steal a thought from Hailey
(for sometimes I feel like Sam)
you've got me wound tighter
than my left-wrist twist
so baby
pull off the road
and let me
get that 
kiss

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]

Pull off the road [[Turn to page ->uplifted]] 
Take their hand [[Turn to page ->hands]] 
Keep going [[Turn to page ->my path]]

passages.name: memory
passages.body:
#memory


puffing cigarettes
and talking about
the good old days
(before all the cigarettes)
meandering through memories
and classic tales
when it strikes
me
the times
are far from over
(really just begun)
so let’s puff another
cigarette and talk
about that 

[3rd line]

Blink [[Turn to page->Intro]]

passages.name: threshold
passages.body:
#threshold


the faintest smile
plays across
those pressed-thin lips
It’s almost as if I can see
a thought dance
across your
synapses
and for a moment
(just a moment)
your eyes shine
so bright I
half expect to
see your imaginings
projected onto
the canvas laid
before you
I can always
feel my breath catch
then,
standing at the threshold
of your world

passages.name: uplifted
passages.body:
#uplifted

and in the park
that day
nothing captivated us
no steel structures
drew our eyes
and so
(in defiance of
our upbringing)
we grew wings
and left the
grass behind


(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]
Fly [[Turn to page ->my eyes]]

passages.name: him
passages.body:
=|=
#him


a grin among the
branches
a smile white with
bone and
drip drip drip
dripping
saliva (sour)
and Abigail screams
and we all
hear her
and no one
hears her
and if she
(SHE)
is scared
so should we all
be
but that grin
a smile white with
bone and
attached a face
pale (but not as
pale as Abigail’s)
his suit unrumpled
and he sits
and the words
begin 
=|=
<img src="https://www.dropbox.com/s/8d6q8w53aew7g7g/PXL_20220212_035504630.jpg?raw=1" width="500">
|==|

Listen [[Turn to page ->blink]] 
Don't listen [[Turn to page ->simpler time]]

passages.name: hands
passages.body:
#hands

there are songs
to sing about
the way
we hold our hands
together
intertwined as if
to find
some token of
remembrance
a simple touch
that holds
back much
of what could
hunt and
find us

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]
Keep holding [[Turn to page ->delight]] 
Pull of the road [[Turn to page ->uplifted]]

passages.name: wanderlust
passages.body:
=|=
#wanderlust

wanderlust
(if lust had
survived the
media smear campaign)
wander-longings
a wander-yearn
puling your heart strings
across this land
up into the mount-
ains
leaving trace amounts
of rubber
forming a crisscrossing
map
veins across
the earth 
=|=
But he was watching wasn't he?
We don't have to talk about him.
We can talk about better days.
|==|

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]
Talk about him [[Turn to page ->him]] 
Talk about better days [[Turn to page ->simpler time]]

it's a government
plot a ploy a plan

reduce our

passages.name: spring
passages.body:
#spring


its almost funny
how little
it takes
these days
a flash of light
in a darkened
pane and the
wheels begin
to spin
those familiar suspicious
gears click
click clicking
into place
but how is
one supposed
to feel in the
spring
once the flowers bloom
every hill
is a grassy knoll 

Get a drink [[Turn to page->CJ]]

passages.name: blink
passages.body:
=|=
#blink


blink and you’’ll
miss it
but never have I
seen them blink
unwavering
they watch
telling him
telling all they
see
and they see most
everything
but they don’t see
her
precious Abigail
always in her Sunday
best
“dress for everyday
as if it’s your last”
a sigh
“between the jello shots
and the Ambien
who can really say?”
born (like the rest of
us) veiled
to the world
killed in the haze of
someone else’s
self-medication
yet here
she stands
hunted
terrified
unafraid
=|=
<img src="https://www.dropbox.com/s/oyhq2q1an2zlaqm/IMG_20220214_231011.jpg?raw=1" width="500">
|==|

passages.name: dad's beer
passages.body:
#dad's beer


and Dad’s beer sat warm in
my stomach
as I pondered slipping clutches
and failing transmissions
flying through the night
grinding gears
up the mountain
starry nights
above me
starry nights
above you
and your car
and here I am wishing
on Dad’s warm beer in
my stomach
that your slipping clutch
and failing transmission
get you
home safe 

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]
Have a smoke[[Turn to page->porch]] 
Have a drink[[Turn to page->drinking]]

passages.name: 70mph
passages.body:
#70mph


sitting and watching
the mile markers
flit away
one eye to the sky
as the clouds lazily
leapfrog each other
and I can’t help
but smile to
think you may be
doing the same,
sitting and watching 
the mile markers
flit away 

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]
Faster [[Turn to page->car crashes]]
Slower [[Turn to page->the rain]]
Stop [[Turn to page->Staunton]]

passages.name: the spider
passages.body:
#the spider


a spider’s leg
  is hovering
over my right
  arm again
it weaves and
  bobs
in time to my
  nervous energy
it fades away
  when I settle
  down
it’s not scary
 (I come to realize)
  just strange
  is this
  life
  now? 
  
  Blink [[Turn to page ->let me tell you]]

passages.name: mistress
passages.body:
mistress
#

And in times of greatest need
I always turn to
poetry
She's a mistress unlike any other
who never screens her calls
she whispers silent nothings
and moans her Verse into
my ear
speaking of any taboo I
wish to hear	
Our relationship is one of
debauchery ripe
with holding of hands
and tender moments
but fear not
dear reader
we are not without
our violent unions
and frigid silences
but as of yet they’ve only
led to a closer tie
and though shes a fictitious
personification
I still love her
smile

passages.name: drinking
passages.body:
#drinking


I've been drinking 
more than I've
been writing
and smoking more
than I drink
and nothing seems
quite so right
as hiding from
the wind
I hear their 
voices softly
whipping
round my
skull
mumbles, cries, screams,
and moans
begin to take
a toll

(text-style:"bold")[What do you do?]

passages.body:
#take the wheel


toss the keys and
shine the headlights
Who has the wheel now?
how loud is their voice?
a simple monotone?
counting
one
1(oneoneoneone)
2358
keeping time to the heart(head)
holding it all in
toss the keys and
shine the headlights
new fingers on
the wheel
and with trembling
hands she lights
a cigarette
I have to kill myself
slowly,
to feel I’m really
alive
Keys?
tossed.
Headlights?
shone.
the new one
the voice from
outside
hands grip the
wheel
tighter
faster
I’m done

happily holding

folding
of simple, miraculous
hands
spirit filling songing
and lip quivering
longing
red stars collapsing and
synapses snapping
with open mouth gasping
as the universe slowly
explodes
and still the
happily holding
and smile filled
folding
of simple, miraculous
hands

passages.name: crackpop
passages.body:
#crackpop


scintillating
sin spat
soar into
the ethersphere
broken bones
spore soaked
sighs run red-
hot rivulets
through my mind
searing shut
my synapses
burning off my
senses
A medic’s
scalpel hastily
heated on a
lighter
the same lighter
that ignited
the cigarette
that
drew the
sniper’s fire
a gunshot
(impersonal)
through the left
eye. ripping
tearing
respectfully
cauterizing
erasing the exit
wound to keep
the roundthought
inside

passages.name: the rain
passages.body:
#the rain


the rain is
 dripping on my
windshield
    and my tattered
wiper blades
  valiantly wipe them
away
  clearing the glass -
  and my mind
  the world goes from
     a blur
  to crystal clear in a
   single slash
 only to fall prey to
   the liquid occlusion
   once again
  yet through this
    futility my
    wipers soldier on
   nobly slicing out
   glimpses of the
   blacktop ahead

passages.name: bees are dying at an alarming rate
passages.body:
#bees are dying at an alarming rate


bees are dying
at an alarming
rate and
I’m looking in a
mirror wondering
if my hair looks
better parted to the
left and
bees are dying
at an alarming
rate and
I don’t know
for sure but
maybe a thousand
died while I
was adjusting my
shirt
and if all the
bees die something
sciencey and
bad happens and
I’m standing
here trying to
decide if I’m
too old for a
lipring and
bees are dying
at an alarming
rate

passages.body:

posing there with abs
glistening
an empty profile
beckoning
and is that all you have to
offer
a six pack and
designer jeans
pushing me to swipe
and fuck
tap and be fucked
so tell me something
more than those abs and
pricey clothes
because I’m cute enough
and I’m charming enough
to be with that soulless
Sixpack
for the 5 dollar cover
at any bar
so tell me something
(anything)
or I will keep swiping
you over my left
shoulder
like salt in the Devil’s
eye

this seems like
the kind of
day

need to focus on
myself
just get some ice
cream
maybe go to the park

#a love poem to myself


I'm the kind
of asshole
who never
returns calls
you're the kind of
asshole
that dubs earth-
shattering screams
into my relaxation
records
your overachieving
ass
is the yang to
my apathy
we make a
dangerous
couple

passages.name: leftwrist twist
passages.body:
#leftwrist twist


Have you ever
been in love?
a smirk a smile
a half-assed grin
do fictitious personifications
count?
if so then
twice but
really just with
one
Hailey (the one
with ribbon at her
wrist)
and her quieter self 
her of smiles and secrets
and silent places
(the one with
ribbon at her wrist)

passages.name: connected
passages.body:
#connected


my fingertips graze
that place on
the back of
your neck
just barely
above the spot
where thoughts
collect and
coalesce
and translate
into movement
and actions
and my fingertips
are my conduit
sharing those signals
moving in time
to your
synaptic
feedback

passages.name: risk
passages.body:
#risk


batwings and butterflies
busted jaws and hurricanes
find your place among
the lost, broken, and sedated
nothing ventured, nothing gained
nothing lost
nothing sane
torn apart
left behind
the lady in the pink dress
says it all
with her silent words
and cricket song
moving slowly
through space and time
not sure how I got here

“haven’t you seen

grass will grow
matadors will be gored

passages.name: changeling
passages.body:
#changeling


the wind blows loose
the multicolor
scintillation
of your hair
and with the
shimmer shammer
fae wings are
drawn to mind
and with those
wings fluttering against
my parietal lobe
it’s barely a step
to smell the fair
folks blood within
your veins
their laugh upon
your lips
their adventure in
your heart

passages.name: deal
passages.body:
#deal


I don’t have
much
but it’s all yours to take
and I’ll strike
a deal
with you
if it flutters your heart
just right
I’ll wrap you in poetry
writing all the words
that come to mind
I’ll hand my soul to
you scribbled on
paper
with a liberal dash
of imagery and
rhyme
and the modest
price I ask
is just a tender
touching of the
lips

passages.name: warmth
passages.body:
#warmth


the warmth always
astonishes me
how can being
so warm
be so comforting
shaking off that
familiar cold
the shawl woven
(and worn with
pride)
of tangled half-
truths(
half-smiles)
half-lies
and yet the warmth
always astonishes
me
always draws me
closer

passages.name: rebellion
passages.body:
#rebellion


swirl and spin
and turn and
Sing
Skyward bound
and determined as
Hell. even
the father can’t
stop us now
with 9 feet
of ribbon we
bind our
left arms to
the sky
reunited

passages.name: Staunton
passages.body:
#Staunton


I’ve spent
 hours on
this unfeeling
 highway
  because lately
when I close my
 eyes all
    I
 see is your
  smile
and I want
  (if only for a
  moment)
for reality
to mirror
my daydreams

passages.name: new eyes
passages.body:
=|=
#new eyes


the privilege of the
emotionally dead
is to never be unsure
no broken fragments
of hidden doubt
florescent fields
of greenred grass
a picture book haunting
of a dirty
back alley
so give me Tricyclics
give me SSRIs
hand me more truth
or at least more trusting eyes

passages.name: car crashes
passages.body:
=|=
#car crashes


and car crashes
are such a
romantic endeavor
the total
and complete
giving of yourself
to the road
A love affair
with
the yellow line
A crimson splash
speckles the road
in the vague outline
of a heart
And we quietly
ate our chinese
food
contemplating the
sudden outpouring of
insight
and the shy one
(with a grin)
began to speak
emboldened by
the chance to
be the clever one
What about the other car?
And the response came
It’s a polyamorous relationship
=|=

as I work on
my epiphany

passages.name: wings
passages.body:
#wings


there are so many
birds overhead
and I can feel my
every cell
call out to them
breaking off and
taking flight
pulled skyward by
the sound of their 
wings

passages.name: dance
passages.body:
#dance


swirling and spinning
twirling about
your legs
white with
blue dots
(of the polka
type)
picking up the
moon's beams
running away from
the ball,
finally finding reason
to dance
“and darling
that dress suits
the night so
well”

passages.name: how many fingers am I holding up?
passages.body:
#how many fingers am I holding up?


how many fingers am
I holding
up
four? seven?
nine?
And why can I
not tell?
I try to count
-burning up-
while my fingers
fade in and out
how many fingers am
I holding
up?
your guess is 
as good as
mine

passages.name: hair
passages.body:
#hair


your hair
between my
fingers
swirling, moving
the tips then linger
holding on
(and holding out)
lost in you
and lost
without

passages.name: cherub
passages.body:
#cherub


fox quick
and sickly
black
writhing across
the forest floor
they slink and
slither
coil and
hide
and I,
watching a cherub
making its way
across
my woods

passages.name: oranges
passages.body:
#oranges


I've always 
loved the
smell of oranges
(especially on
your skin)
they have a zest
that screams
adventure
(nights flying down
the highway)
and that hint of acid
(“Get a job, you're 
not man enough
for me”)
but mostly they
remind me of
(you)

passages.name: when I say your name
passages.body:
#when I say your name


and when I say your
name
(your starlight
in my
eyes)
I hear the sound
of horses,
of chaos,
and a fire
but the taste on
my lips 
is of 
cider and 
sunfire

passages.name: back on the road
passages.body:
#back on the road


I'm back on
the road
after what feels
like forever
my hands still itch
to throw myself
onto the wrong side
the road keeps
coming
flying past
and all I can do
is sigh

#1001


one zero zero
one
everyone the rain
1001everyonetherain
one
zero zero
one
everyone the rain

passages.name: lines
passages.body:
#lines


the lines in my eyes
are getting wider
all the time
it's getting harder now
to peer past them
and see the stars
so clear

passages.name: homeward bound
passages.body:
#homeward bound


homeward bound
but already
there
I'm holding out
(onto a prayer)
and do you
remember that day
six years from 
now?
Well hold my drink
I think I'm 
done

passages.name: burn out
passages.body:
#burn out


I'm a burn out
hopped up
and let down
hoping I'm not
too washed up
to get the 
message out
just praying
that my words
will touch something
inside you
help and guide
you to a
happier home

passages.name: the ending
passages.body:
#the ending


I kindly suggest you
back off
cause I'm about
to pop off
show up
throw down
now you know
whats going round
it's just that sometimes
I feel so empty
but even then it 
thrills me
feeling all the things
that could kill me
I'm left just thinking
bout the ending
and wondering where
that release could
send me

passages.name: allensville
passages.body:
#allensville


there's a place
where the river
meets the road
and underneath
lies my heart
beat, beat,
beating
like graffiti
done in oil
pastel
just out of reach
of the stormy
season
the water always
lapping, try
trying
but never quite
reaching high
enough

passages.name: thank you
passages.body:
#thank you


when I coughed
my lung fell out
and spilled
into my coffee
and you handed
me a napkin
to blot the
wetness from my
tie
thank you for that

passages.name: so many
passages.body:
#so many


“you've got so many
hands”
I remember telling
her
as we lay by the
stream
ans she smiled and 
hushed me
“you've got so many
fears”
and then we both 
grew some
more

passages.name: full of eyes
passages.body:
#full of eyes


I'm full of eyes
and my eyes
are full
of something 
not much unlike 
tears
and the moon is
full of secret bases
hidden in their
secret places
and I don't know
what to do

passages.name: chemicals
passages.body:
#chemicals


fire hearted
but yellow-bellied
never stable
always steadied
droves of chemicals
swirl in my brain
slowing images of
sinister pain
holding back that
unquenchable longing
stopping the stars
of their strange, sad songing
droves of chemicals
swim in my brain

passages.name: bullets
passages.body:
#bullets

Nights like this make
   me want to
  drive a heated
 knife deep inside my
head
  I just want the red-
   hot tip to touch the firing
 pins of the bullets that line
 my brain
    because lately my
  mind has felt like bullets
   every thought so sudden
      jarring
       scary
        loud
Ijust(dangerous)needthesebulletsoutofme
  and I don't know
   if a firing pin is even
      how bullets work
  I don't understand bullets
     I don't understand much

passages.name: song
passages.body:
#song

“Its like shes dancing…
can’t she ever just
walk?”
and dance
we(she)
did
bouncing past
toiletries
waltzing amongst
the produce
and from the
front pocket
blasted the
song
that song
that holds
it all together
the one that
Hailey
sings/sang/sung

passages.name: morning
passages.body:
#morning

I just don’t think you
understand just
how great the
morning is
I get up early
rivaling even the
birds
and celebrate
making it through
another night
with a victory
cigarette
for my hero
(pointed tipward to the sky)
It's not every night
you fall from grace
so I think that
is ample cause
for celebration

passages.name: toby
passages.body:
#toby

the dog’s gentle snores
prod at me
yelling that I shouldn’t
be here
there is a bed waiting
just a few footfalls
away a bed
that offers warmth
and comfort
and companionship
yet still I sit
listening to the dog’s
gentle snoring
my eyes dance
searching for spies
in a room devoid
of all life
save myself
and a gently snoring
dog

passages.name: me(bothofus)
passages.body:
me(bothofus)

her eyes
  burning into me
Sliding
please allow us to introduce ourselves
his name is irony
  and he’s normally in control
and him,
  just ignore him
he makes the decisions
   at least the ones that really
     matter
let’s see what we can
   do about
making this a little easier
  let me pour you a
    drink

passages.name: sins
passages.body:
#sins

sing and swallow something sold
sound of sorrow
sins unfold
pour a drink
drain another
lies are told
lose a lover
sing and swallow something sold
sound of sorrow
sins unfold
drain another
pour one more
truth is told
soul left sore
sing and swallow something sold
sound of silence
sins unfold

passages.name: introspective poetry
passages.body:
#introspective poetry

writing introspective
poetry can
  be such
a drag
so lets focus
instead on
  bees
they bumble and
drift
  spreading life
  and making
  sweets

you can thank me
  for this poem
   later

passages.name: lies, alright?
passages.body:
#lies, alright?

splashing colors
swirling sounds
the words not spoken
burn in my skull
whispers
(vile) sinister
with undulating
ill intent
sequestered in my mind
a simple song
of glorious suspicions
the so called antics of
a childless child
stormy weather, wind-
tossed bows
a fire burning in
the heart of the
dog
(god) an angry conclusion
a far-stretched
notion
of unquenchable longing
star-speckled eyes
sear me into
ashy nothingness
a flurry of sparks
from the ancient blacksmith’s
hammer
send quivers down my
brain stem
a black cat and
a bottle of pills
what a gut wrenching
invention
for one so full of suspicion

passages.name: pretentious crap
passages.body:
#pretentious crap


a cyclonic path of everbuilding doubt
a fragile pretense
shattered
by the mind altering
chemicals that
hold me accountable
for actions I have
yet to conceive
gut-wrenching, bowel-turning, blood-
curdling
streams of semi-viscous
sin
pour forth from my eyes
and bring life to my 
senses
pseudogenesis
twisted tale of creation
and on the seventh day he
rested
sometimes God gets all the
breaks

passages.name: revolutions
passages.body:
#revolutions


forsooth the truth
behold
untold
the needless naught
of which we
were taught
the untrue truth
that binds us
from our youth
And with that I’m done
with Mark’s
style
(for he kindly stays from mine)
what I’m trying to
say
is keep yourself
from other’s words
and find what you must
find

passages.name: heretic
passages.body:
#heretic

everytime I open my
mouth the
words
spill onto my paper
drip drip
dripping
into your eyes
but listen not to my
words
for I am not a poet
I am a heretic
and these
words
my words
will linger like
cancer
of the soul
my words
will decay your
morals
and cast you out of
the grace of
god
for my
poetry
my poetry
is blasphemy

passages.name: texts
passages.body:
#texts


I spend so much
time rerereading
texts
making sure they
trigger some
synaptic crackfiresnap,
some memory
(no matter how ill-
defined)
I'm scared you see.
I've been losing time
(cracks in the plaster (running counter
to the cracks I'm familiar
with))
and reading these
texts
is the only way to know
I haven't lost time
with you

passages.name: long nights in a shitty motel
passages.body:
#long nights in a shitty motel

 I wrote it on my arm
     last night
if lack of memory
    serves me right
I don’t really remember
  yesterday
  and less still of the
day before
   but I must have
found something in
that green haze
for here the beauty lies
simple, serene, resounding
  truth
it’s indisputable really
     “I AM I”

passages.name: rebirth
passages.body:
rebirth

the root of
metempsychois
is still just
psychosis
can I have the
metem-
free of its dependee?
 or is it all
just
circles?

passages.name: untitled
passages.body:
untitled

Thrashed about
beaten and broken
understood to be
simply a token
of insecurity
lies
and mistrust
lost in this world of cardboard and plastic
sin finds my soul decayed and placid
what truth can be found
from an electron-speckled screen
Nothing
forever
never to be seen
life is a fiction written by fools
from inside their safe walls
built with misguided tools
save me.
